system.description:
Unchecked growth leads to rot. Nature must take its course for new life to emerge, best guided by a wise hand.

LEVEL 3

Controlled Burn. You unlock Fire spells. After upcasting a spell or critting in beastform, you may inflict Smoldering on a creature within Range 6.

LEVEL 7

Flash Fire. Inflict Smoldering when you crit with a Lightning spell.

Fan the Flames. Your Wind spells have advantage against Smoldering creatures.

LEVEL 11

Wildfire. (1/encounter) Deal LVL+WIL fire damage to all enemies with Smoldering within Range 6, ending the condition.

LEVEL 15

From the Ashes. (1/Safe Rest) Action (while Dying): Expend all remaining Hit Dice. You heal for the amount rolled, and deal that much fire damage to all adjacent enemies.
